in_hebrew.name: Burg
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Burg הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German words burh and burg, meaning a fortified hill or a stronghold. Historically, Burg was a common name for settlements and fortresses in the Middle Ages.

in_greek.name: Burg
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Fortified hill
in_greek.long_meaning: Burg είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old German words burh and burg, meaning a fortified hill or a stronghold. Historically, Burg was a common name for settlements and fortresses in the Middle Ages.

in_latin.name: Burg
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Fortified hill
